priority: Reduce host board cost with classic ESP32 while retaining local services, three independent external 2.4 GHz antennas and direct-solder finished modules.

assembly.method: All components face front; male module pins enter plated holes and solder on the back. TinyC6 headers require through-hole assembly first.
assembly.initial_programming: Program each loose controller before mounting; use the revision-specific network updater after assembly.
assembly.thread_preparation: TinyC6-U-01 native USB, no H2 USB-UART resistor removal.

active_enclosure.status: full-hub engineering prototype; physical fit, force, thermal and RF qualification outstanding
active_enclosure.antenna_mount: Three independent standard-SMA bulkheads in fixed base wall; separate 150 mm U.FL-compatible pigtails. ZAC93 retains its stock antenna; CC1101 has a separate band-matched antenna.
active_enclosure.scope: MC2-B carrier, isolated Waveshare DC PoE splitter, Pololu buck, DFR0627 bridge, ZAC93, CC1101, DC adapter, fuse, lid-mounted LD2450 and attached ventilated BME680 pod.
active_enclosure.qualification: Digital envelopes and print geometry only; check exact delivered hardware and connector variants before assembly.

historical_designs.reason: MC2 selects factory external-antenna host/C6 modules and an explicit external MG24 image; MC1 geometry and firmware remain separate.
Superseded by classic ESP32 host in MC2-B; different footprint, pin map, target binary and node identity.

release_policy: One current design does not imply a validated manufacturing release. Hardware operation, physical fit and simultaneous-load acceptance remain separate gates.
active_bluetooth: Bluetooth LE 4.2; legacy advertisements and active connections; no BLE 5 extended advertisements or Coded PHY
